0.1.0.lead: The first version of nexbrand: your clients' corporate design in one place, with every version, the checks that go with it and the way into code.

sections.title: Clients and their design sets
sections.body: Colours with roles and print values, fonts with their licence, logos with their ground, type sizes, rules and example files. Each colour shows its scale from 50 to 950 and its contrast with white and dark.

sections.title: Versions on a time line
sections.where: At the top of a client's page
sections.body: Every change is a draft first; publishing gives it the day it holds from, and then it stays as it is. “As of” shows any day, “3 years ago” is one click. Two versions side by side show what changed. Projects keep their version and move only when somebody moves them.

sections.title: Checks that are computed
sections.where: A client's “Checks” tab, and Contrast in the top bar
sections.body: Contrast of every pair by WCAG 2.2, logos at 3:1, colour vision deficiencies, colours nearly the same, text too small, fonts that may not leave the house. The contrast calculator proposes the nearest colour of the same hue that passes.

sections.title: Make a new CI and agree on it
sections.body: Start from a few words, a picture, one colour or nothing. The workbench proposes harmonies, neutrals, a font pair and sizes, with a sample page and the checks running next to it. The directions go to the client by link; their choice becomes version 1.0.

sections.title: Collect from a website, a repository or a PDF
sections.body: Colours, fonts and logos are measured and sorted, by rules or by your own AI. They become a draft, or you check a site against the CI and find the nearly right shades. The operator opens websites and repositories under Settings, Server, Collecting and AI.

sections.title: As code, over the API and MCP
sections.where: “As code” on a client's page; tokens under My account, Connections
sections.body: Every version as CSS variables, a Tailwind 4 theme, SCSS or design tokens. Programs read over /api/v1, an AI in an editor over MCP. A token of the level “draft” writes a redesign back, always as a draft.

small: Public links show a design set read only, a fixed version or always the current one, with an end date and a password.
nexbrand runs on its own or as part of the suite with nexsuite (Settings, Server, nexsuite).
Accounts, second factor, sign-in through OIDC with an authentik button, log, languages and backups as in nexlore.
